entries.title: II Peter 1:1
segments: To them that have obtained a like precious faith with us.  Those who, whether Jews or Gentiles, held a faith like that held by Peter.

entries.title: II Peter 1:2
segments: Knowledge of God. In the original the word here translated 'knowledge' (epignosis) has the deeper meaning of that understanding which is developed through love.  The same word occurs in

entries.title: II Peter 1:9
segments: Blind, seeing only what is near. This phrase implies a lack of perception as to spiritual things and undue attention to the allurements of the world.

entries.title: II Peter 1:10
segments: Your calling and election sure. All Christians have been called, but they must work out their salvation.

entries.title: II Peter 1:19
segments: And we have the world of prophecy made more sure. All question as to the fulfilment of the prophecies as to the coming of the Messiah in the person of Jesus were removed for Peter by the wonders of which he had been an eye-witness (2Pe 1.16-18).
